annotations.title: Change a creator campaign, or set it live, paused, closed or reopened

description: Change a campaign's brief, money (budgetUsd: raise only once live; economics while a draft), visibility, usage rights, dates, caps, requirements, hold or sign-up page (page, questions, slug), Everything stays editable while live: a change to pay, the hold or usage rights becomes a new terms version (the answer says who it applies to). Status: active (live: creators can join and submit), paused (no new posts; tracking continues), closed (the join link stops, no new posts or views count, approved earnings stay payable, a pool campaign splits its pool among approved posts by views; a budget is a limit, so nothing is refunded) or reopen (a closed campaign goes live again, or back to draft if it never went live; not possible once a pool share was paid). CLOSE AND REOPEN ARE CONFIRM-GATED: without confirm:true nothing changes and the answer lists exactly what the step does; show the user, then call again with confirm:true. A closed campaign's settings are read-only until it is reopened. The budget can go down only to what creators already earned.

applyToExisting.description: a live change to pay, hold or usage rights is a new terms version for new joiners; creators who joined: none = keep theirs (default), offer = they may accept, all = move them (pay increases only)

assets.description: files or links creators may use

autoAccept.description: with joinApproval manual: creators who match the campaign's niches and countries and reach minFollowers join automatically; null turns it off

brief.description: what to post: the product, the angle, do and do not, links

budgetUsd.description: the most all creators together can earn (required for cpm); can be raised while live

confirm.description: required to close or reopen, after the user has seen what it does

contentTypes.description: content wanted, e.g. UGC with face, Clipping

countries.description: 2-letter countries the campaign is for (marketplace, auto-accept); empty = anywhere

customPlatforms.description: any other platform by name (e.g. Twitch, a podcast): creators enter views, you approve them

economics.description: the payout model; fixed once live

milestones.description: one-time bonus when a post reaches views

platformRatesUsd.description: a per-1,000 rate per platform, e.g. {"tiktok": 3}

type.description: custom (default): any mix of perPostUsd, ratePer1kUsd and milestones; pool: poolUsd split by views at close

holdDays.description: how long approved earnings wait before they can be paid, 0 to 60 (default 10): your window to reject a bad post

joinApproval.description: open = anyone with the link joins; manual = you approve each one

landingUrl.description: an https link creators can point people to

maxPostAgeHours.description: how old a post may be when submitted (default 72)

name.description: what creators see the campaign called

niches.description: up to 5 categories the campaign is for (marketplace listing, filters, auto-accept), e.g. beauty, fitness, tech, food, gaming

notifyCreators.description: email a creator when their post or draft is approved, rejected or sent back

page.description: sign-up page look: https image links (upload_file makes one); starts with the brand's logo and colour; only sent fields change

blocks.description: up to 20 page blocks in order; replaces the list

html.description: sanitized: no scripts, forms, styles or event handlers; iframes only for the video players above

url.description: image: https; video: a YouTube/Vimeo/TikTok/Loom/Instagram link or an mp4

examples.description: up to 8 example posts, images or videos

questions.description: up to 10 questions creators answer when joining; replaces the list

requireConnected.description: creators must connect each account by signing in on the platform (TikTok, Instagram, X, Threads); typed handles refused

requireDraftApproval.description: creators upload a draft (up to 500 MB) for your approval before posting

requirements.description: what each post should carry; a missing hashtag, mention or label is flagged for you, never auto-rejected

disclosure.description: flag posts with no #ad / paid-partnership label (default true)

submitConfirm.description: a line creators confirm on every submission

startsAt.description: date posts must be published after (default: when it goes live)

trackingDays.description: how long after submission a post's views keep counting, 1 to 365 (default 30)

adPlatforms.description: ad platform ids, e.g. meta, google_ads, tiktok_ads, snapchat_ads (an unknown id is refused with the list)

allPaidAds.description: as paid ads on any ad platform

amount.description: with term days (1-3650), months (1-120) or years (1-10)

organic.description: reposts on the brand's own social accounts

other.description: any other use in your words, shown verbatim, e.g. "TV"

perpetual.description: true = no end date (same as term perpetual)

term.description: how long after a post is approved the brand may use it; perpetual = forever

webEmail.description: on the brand's website and in its emails

usageRights.description: usage rights asked for: a duration and at least one use; each creator agrees on joining (recorded). Never a gate. null = none

visibility.description: private = personal invites only; unlisted (default) = anyone with the link; public = also listed in the creator marketplace (needs a payment method on file; a brand's first public campaign is reviewed by Hermoso)
